name: touch_rugby_benchmark_2
description: A vision benchmark focused on understanding and analyzing touch-rugby gameplay from visual data. It measures models' abilities on tasks such as action recognition, event detection, and player/team localization in video or image sequences. The benchmark is intended for evaluating sports analytics and multi-agent visual understanding systems.
evaluation_method: accuracy / mean average precision (mAP) depending on task
reputation: A niche, community-maintained dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in sports-analytics and action-recognition research.
